title: Regularity with separable residue field characterizes smoothness over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $S$ be a finite type $k$-algebra ($S\cong k[x_1,\dots,x_n]/\mathfrak a$ as $k$-algebras), and let $\mathfrak q\subset S$ be a prime ideal. Let $S_{\mathfrak q}$ be the localization of $S$ at $S\setminus\mathfrak q$ and let $\kappa(\mathfrak q)=S_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak qS_{\mathfrak q}$ be its residue field [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], regarded as a field extension of $k$ through $k\to S\to\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ [def-pc-field-extension]. If $\kappa(\mathfrak q)/k$ is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension], then $k\to S$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal] if and only if $S_{\mathfrak q}$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme].
